about: THE FOR-YOU STRESS FIXTURE (lane foryou-honest, 2026-10-25): the 21 open agent questions of the stress evaluation (the duo demo's stress-asks.sh — four synthetic conversations, every choice written as PROSE in the detail, options=null) + one contracts question so the totals are the brief's: 21 open, six on one conversation.
